breaking.change: Removed from src/browser/helpers.ts and therefore from the `@orkestrel/test/browser` barrel. It forwarded its one argument unchanged to `userEvent.keyboard` from the declared peer `vitest` (peerDependencies vitest ^4.1.11 at package.json:100-102), adding no boundary, invariant, composition, translation, lifecycle, or narrower contract. The installed declaration node_modules/@vitest/browser/context.d.ts carries `keyboard: (text: string) => Promise<void>` — same arity, same parameter type, same return type. No re-export of `userEvent` was added, because .claude/rules/architecture.md § Wrapper test forbids re-exporting a dependency's symbol. No capability is lost: the replacement is an import the consumer already has.

No fleet package imports `pressKeys`. A grep for the identifier across /home/user/fleet excluding node_modules returned only this package's own tests/src/browser/helpers.test.ts, this package's own guides/test.md, and the vendored guides/test.md mirrors in the other fleet targets — and a mirror refreshes from this package's release rather than importing it, so it needs no patch and takes the refreshed guide when this package publishes. -import { pressKeys } from '@orkestrel/test/browser'
